appearance_facts.fact: The line rises from just under 1,000 at 1880 to about 1,200 at 1881 and about 1,700 at 1882.
The line dips slightly at 1883 to about 1,600, rises to about 1,700 at 1884, and then climbs to about 2,050 at 1885.
The line continues upward to about 2,450 at 1886, about 2,750 at 1887, about 2,850 at 1888, about 2,850 at 1889, and peaks at about 3,100 at 1890.
The line falls from the 1890 peak to about 2,900 at 1891, remaining well above the 1880 level.
The endpoint at 1891 is substantially higher than the startpoint at 1880, with the main change being an increase over the decade.
